description:
Perfect for families groups or business travelers this spacious two bedroom apartment offers comfort and flexibility in the heart of Nashville. Enjoy two private bedrooms a full kitchen open living space in unit laundry and fast WiFi. Relax with access to resort style amenities including the pool fitness center and shared lounges all just minutes from downtown and WeHo hotspots.

The space
Enjoy a stylish Nashville stay in this fully furnished retreat—perfect for extended visits. Relax in modern, thoughtfully designed spaces with a full kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi, and cozy living areas. Conveniently located near downtown, top dining, live music, and local hotspots, you’ll have easy access to everything Music City has to offer.
